title: The Half of It
score_note: chemistry in the letters, a bff turn and two gestures

beats.name: GHOSTWRITING IN SQUAHAMISH
cap: ellie writes other students' essays and
watches aster from a distance
beats.tag: SETUP — invisible in her own town

beats.name: PAUL'S COMMISSION
cap: paul asks her to ghostwrite a love letter
to aster; she agrees for the money
beats.tag: ARRANGEMENT — a business deal that finds a voice

beats.name: THE LETTERS
cap: posing as paul, ellie finds a mind that
answers her own; a teacher pushes grinnell
beats.tag: CORRESPONDENCE — the real romance is written

beats.name: THE FIRST DATE
cap: paul is tongue-tied and the first date fails;
ellie watches from outside the restaurant
beats.tag: FAILURE — the persona outshines the boy

beats.name: THE BULLIES
cap: paul defends ellie from the bullies and
she starts teaching him art and literature
beats.tag: THE TURN — he proves worth the effort

beats.name: THE TALENT SHOW
cap: paul stops the sabotage and ellie gets a
standing ovation; he finds her campaign
beats.tag: RECIPROCITY — each one makes the other braver

beats.name: THE HOT SPRING
cap: aster takes ellie to a hot spring and tells
her that trig intends to marry her
beats.tag: CONFESSION — two people telling the truth

beats.name: THE KISS AT THE DOOR
cap: seeing ellie's words in paul, aster kisses
him; ellie mails the grinnell application
beats.tag: MISREADING — the story slips out of her hands

beats.name: THE FOOTBALL GAME
cap: paul scores and tries to kiss ellie; she
refuses and he calls her a sinner
beats.tag: RUPTURE — the wrong person finds out

beats.name: THE CHURCH PROPOSAL
cap: ellie and then paul interrupt trig's proposal;
aster hears her own letter read aloud
beats.tag: REVEAL — the author of the letters stands up

beats.name: THE GOODBYES
cap: aster refuses trig for art school and kisses
ellie; paul runs beside the departing train
beats.tag: RESOLUTION — she leaves, and she is seen off
